_comment: Fallback ad-network config. Google AdSense only approves sites on a custom
domain, so until the domain + approval are done this file lets you run a
second network that DOES accept *.pages.dev (Adsterra, HilltopAds, Exoclick,
1. Sign up at https://www.adsterra.com/ (publisher sign-up) and add your site URL.
2. Create an ad unit (Banner 728x90 or Social Ads) and copy the <script> snippet.
3. Paste it below (top / side / foot) and set enabled to true.
When AdSense approves your domain, set "enabled" to false and flip
adsenseApproved to true in ads.js - never run two ad networks on one page.
